The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had an '''outpost''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]. Located in [[Collo Fauale Pass]], they retreated there after their original base on the planet was attacked by the [[Crimson Empire]].
